message: No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching with checksum verification, signed URLs, pinned revisions, or source authentication is visible anywhere in the provided code snippets.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is present in the visible data preparation code path.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads models and checkpoints (e.g., via torch.load() and thelper.nn.create_model) but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible in the provided snippets.
No detected label distribution validation: No code in the provided slice checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the provided training pipeline code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy mechanisms (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, or similar) are imported or applied in the provided code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, cleverhans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While separate train/valid/test loaders are created, there is no evidence of signed or hashed evaluation data, cryptographic isolation of the test set, or multiple independent metric sources to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is visible in the inference data-flow path; inputs are passed directly to loaders and the model without sanitization.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model outputs (NaN guards, probability bounds, calibrated thresholds) are present in the visible inference code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision/classification ML framework, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
